SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
As a leading member of the power generation engineering team, you will design, build, and activate technically advanced power plants and generation infrastructure. As a lead engineer, you will lead a team designing, building, and maintaining electrical power systems that directly contribute to new power generation projects. You will be able to operate with autonomy to solve diverse and complex problems, excel at managing multiple projects simultaneously, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You will work with electrical, mechanical, controls, and other engineering disciplines, trade partners, and internal customers to support these goals.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Lead a team of engineers and work in a team environment with other engineering disciplines to provide detailed electrical design and specifications for the installation of the following equipment and systems:
Electrical power distribution systems for power generation plants.
Switchgear and motor control centers.
Plant and yard lighting.
Power plant control systems and ladder logic.
Uninterruptible power supply (UPS) units.
Standby, emergency, and black-start generators.
Automatic transfer switches.
Power monitoring hardware and software.
Plant communications, control network, and wiring.
Plant and equipment grounding systems.
Fire alarm systems and lightning protection systems.
Provide electrical engineering support to power plant technicians and operators to troubleshoot existing electrical equipment and controllers.
Provide engineering support for the design, operation, and troubleshooting of all power plant electrical components and systems, including:
Load flow analysis of electrical power distribution systems.
Electrical equipment evaluation.
Plant and equipment grounding.
Power monitoring hardware and software.
Ensure that all equipment interfaces properly with other mechanical and electrical systems, including compatibility with plant power budgets.
Coordinate all electrical installations and maintenance activities with local electrical utilities personnel.
Ensure all electrical designs and installations conform to applicable codes and regulations.
Provide code review and analysis utilizing NFPA 70E, NFPA 70 NEC, NFPA 497, NFPA 101, NESC, IEEE, and IBC.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

About the Team
The Code Scalability team owns build systems and continuous integration across DoorDash. When a shared dependency changes or more teams contribute to a monorepo, the cost of building software can grow for everyone. We tackle that challenge with Bazel, Buildkite, and infrastructure that keeps everyday development efficient. Our work gives teams a dependable path from a code change to a completed build, with fewer delays and less infrastructure troubleshooting.
About the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer on Code Scalability, you will solve the engineering problems behind building software at DoorDash’s scale. A change deep in a monorepo can trigger work across many projects; your job is to make that work efficient, predictable, and easy to investigate when something goes wrong. Projects span Bazel configuration and tooling, Buildkite orchestration, build execution and caching, and the services that support them. You will identify where improvements matter most, make the technical decisions, and work with teams across DoorDash to put those changes into practice. The impact of this role extends to every team that depends on our platform. Shorter queues give engineers more time to iterate, dependable pipelines prevent interruptions, and useful diagnostics help them get back to their work. You will measure progress through those outcomes, alongside the cost and maintainability of the infrastructure you own.
You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…
Evolve build and CI workflows for large monorepos, keeping feedback fast and changes manageable as dependencies, code volume, and the number of contributing teams grow.
Develop Bazel rules, toolchains, and integrations that keep builds reproducible and make shared build infrastructure easier for teams to adopt across large monorepos.
Improve Buildkite pipeline throughput and reliability by reducing queue times, addressing build bottlenecks, and making better use of CI compute capacity.
Reduce redundant build work through dependency analysis, incremental builds, caching, and parallel execution, balancing developer feedback speed with infrastructure cost.
Build developer tools that explain build failures and help engineers reproduce CI behavior locally, making troubleshooting faster and reducing support overhead.
Rethink what a build and CI platform can do with AI: move beyond reporting failures toward intelligent diagnosis, PR triage, automated recovery, and guidance that helps developers move forward.
Instrument and operate build and CI infrastructure. Use metrics and developer feedback to track latency, reliability, and resource usage, then address recurring infrastructure problems.
Lead platform improvements from design through rollout, partner with engineering teams on migrations, and mentor teammates through technical decisions and code reviews.

You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, including building developer infrastructure, build systems, or CI platforms.

You approach internal platforms as products: you listen to developers, make workflows easier to adopt, and judge success by the problems you solve for them.

회사 소개
쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.
쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.
쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

당신의 경험과 역량이 새로운 클라우드 비즈니스의 성장을 만듭니다.

지금 인재풀에 등록하시면, 향후 적합한 포지션이 열릴 때 우선적으로 검토 및 연락드릴 예정입니다.

Role Overview
The Search & Discovery organization is responsible for optimizing customers' navigation experience and driving long-term growth. Every week millions of customers use search in our app or on coupang.com, more than one third of them make purchases. Over half of the Coupang sales are directly attributed to search and recommendation. Many business initiatives and growth strategies are driven or boosted by ranking and recommendation.
This role is an opportunity to build scalable offline and online ML platforms to support ranking and recommendation, and business decision making. You will be handling billions of records of user interaction data, and petabytes of raw log files, and transforming them into data objects that can be easily consumed by engineers and scientists. You will also be responsible for serving complex ML models in real time to help millions of Coupang customers search and discover products. If you are passionate about big data engineering and scalable serving systems, you want to make real business impact, and you are a true problem solver, this is the right job for you.
What You Will do

jobs.description: Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? What if you could build the AI-powered systems that make that happen — and make it faster, cheaper, and more sustainable? Watch this video to learn more about our organization, SCOT: http://bit.ly/amazon-scot Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization is responsible for the end-to-end systems that plan, optimize, and execute the movement of billions of packages across the world's most complex logistics network. We build real-time, intelligent, and fully automated systems that touch every aspect of the delivery experience — from the moment a customer clicks "Buy" to the package arriving at their door. What you'll work on: - You'll join a team within SCOT that's pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI and algorithms in transportation: - AI-Powered Network Automation – Build agentic AI systems that continuously monitor, optimize, and autonomously evolve one of the world's largest transportation networks. You'll work on systems that generate, validate, and deploy network configurations using large language models and advanced automation — moving toward a future where the network intelligently adapts itself. - Route Optimization at Scale – Design and implement graph algorithms that find optimal routes across a massive, multi-modal transportation network — optimizing simultaneously for speed, cost, and environmental sustainability. You'll solve multi-variable optimization problems at a scale few companies in the world operate at. - Scalable Distributed Systems – Build highly available, low-latency services that process millions of decisions in real-time, powering the backbone of Amazon's transportation planning and execution What we're looking for: - Strong foundations in data structures, algorithms, and system design - Experience with or passion for: graph algorithms, optimization, AI/ML systems, or generative AI - Ability to break down ambiguous, complex problems into elegant, shippable solutions - Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where you own your systems end-to-end - Excellent communication skills and a track record of raising the engineering bar on your team
